name: claude-code-aws
description: Independently installable Claude Code plugins for AWS development. Plugins are listed only after they pass tests and the installed-from-cache check.

plugins.name: aws-context
plugins.description: Verified AWS account, principal, region, and environment for the current project, with a status skill and a session-start check. Read-only: it never changes AWS resources.

plugins.name: aws-ui
plugins.description: Shows the verified AWS account, region, and environment in a compact band above the prompt, read from the aws-context snapshot, with an opt-in status-line fallback. Never calls AWS.
